en.text: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.

zhSimplified.text: 我们既已得救，才知道那岛名叫马耳他。

zhTraditional.text: 我們既已得救，才知道那島名叫馬耳他。

en.text: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

zhSimplified.text: 土人看待我们，有非常的情分；因为当时下雨，天气又冷，就生火接待我们众人。

zhTraditional.text: 土人看待我們，有非常的情分；因為當時下雨，天氣又冷，就生火接待我們眾人。

en.text: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，保罗拾起一捆柴，放在火上，有一条毒蛇，因为热了出来，咬住他的手。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，保羅拾起一捆柴，放在火上，有一條毒蛇，因為熱了出來，咬住他的手。

en.text: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

zhSimplified.text: 土人看见那毒蛇悬在他手上，就彼此说：「这人必是个凶手，虽然从海里救上来，天理还不容他活着。」

zhTraditional.text: 土人看見那毒蛇懸在他手上，就彼此說：「這人必是個兇手，雖然從海裏救上來，天理還不容他活着。」

en.text: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

zhSimplified.text: 保罗竟把那毒蛇甩在火里，并没有受伤。

zhTraditional.text: 保羅竟把那毒蛇甩在火裏，並沒有受傷。

en.text: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

zhSimplified.text: 土人想他必要肿起来，或是忽然仆倒死了；看了多时，见他无害，就转念，说：「他是个神。」

zhTraditional.text: 土人想他必要腫起來，或是忽然仆倒死了；看了多時，見他無害，就轉念，說：「他是個神。」

en.text: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

zhSimplified.text: 离那地方不远，有田产是岛长部百流的；他接纳我们，尽情款待三日。

zhTraditional.text: 離那地方不遠，有田產是島長部百流的；他接納我們，盡情款待三日。

en.text: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

zhSimplified.text: 当时，部百流的父亲患热病和痢疾躺着。保罗进去，为他祷告，按手在他身上，治好了他。

zhTraditional.text: 當時，部百流的父親患熱病和痢疾躺着。保羅進去，為他禱告，按手在他身上，治好了他。

en.text: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.

zhSimplified.text: 从此，岛上其余的病人也来，得了医治。

zhTraditional.text: 從此，島上其餘的病人也來，得了醫治。

en.text: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

zhSimplified.text: 他们又多方地尊敬我们；到了开船的时候，也把我们所需用的送到船上。

zhTraditional.text: 他們又多方地尊敬我們；到了開船的時候，也把我們所需用的送到船上。

en.text: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

zhSimplified.text: 过了三个月，我们上了亚历山大的船往前行；这船以「宙斯双子」为记，是在那海岛过了冬的。

zhTraditional.text: 過了三個月，我們上了亞歷山大的船往前行；這船以「宙斯雙子」為記，是在那海島過了冬的。

en.text: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

zhSimplified.text: 到了叙拉古，我们停泊三日；

zhTraditional.text: 到了敘拉古，我們停泊三日；

en.text: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

zhSimplified.text: 又从那里绕行，来到利基翁。过了一天，起了南风，第二天就来到部丢利。

zhTraditional.text: 又從那裏繞行，來到利基翁。過了一天，起了南風，第二天就來到部丟利。

en.text: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

footnotes.text: 28:14 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

zhSimplified.text: 在那里遇见弟兄们，请我们与他们同住了七天。这样，我们来到罗马。

zhTraditional.text: 在那裏遇見弟兄們，請我們與他們同住了七天。這樣，我們來到羅馬。

en.text: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.

zhSimplified.text: 那里的弟兄们一听见我们的信息就出来，到亚比乌市和三馆地方迎接我们。保罗见了他们，就感谢 神，放心壮胆。

zhTraditional.text: 那裏的弟兄們一聽見我們的信息就出來，到亞比烏市和三館 地方迎接我們。保羅見了他們，就感謝上帝，放心壯膽。

en.text: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

zhSimplified.text: 进了罗马城，保罗蒙准和一个看守他的兵另住在一处。

footnotes.text: - 28:16 有古卷加：百夫长把众囚犯交给御营的统领，惟有

zhTraditional.text: 進了羅馬城，保羅蒙准和一個看守他的兵另住在一處。

footnotes.text: - 28:16 有古卷加：百夫長把眾囚犯交給御營的統領，惟有

en.text: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

zhSimplified.text: 过了三天，保罗请犹太人的首领来。他们来了，就对他们说：「弟兄们，我虽没有做什么事干犯本国的百姓和我们祖宗的规条，却被锁绑，从耶路撒冷解在罗马人的手里。

zhTraditional.text: 過了三天，保羅請猶太人的首領來。他們來了，就對他們說：「弟兄們，我雖沒有做甚麼事干犯本國的百姓和我們祖宗的規條，卻被鎖綁，從耶路撒冷解在羅馬人的手裏。

en.text: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

zhSimplified.text: 他们审问了我，就愿意释放我；因为在我身上，并没有该死的罪。

zhTraditional.text: 他們審問了我，就願意釋放我；因為在我身上，並沒有該死的罪。

en.text: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

zhSimplified.text: 无奈犹太人不服，我不得已，只好上告于凯撒，并非有什么事要控告我本国的百姓。

zhTraditional.text: 無奈猶太人不服，我不得已，只好上告於凱撒，並非有甚麼事要控告我本國的百姓。

en.text: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

zhSimplified.text: 因此，我请你们来见面说话，我原为以色列人所指望的，被这链子捆锁。」

zhTraditional.text: 因此，我請你們來見面說話，我原為以色列人所指望的，被這鍊子捆鎖。」

en.text: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：「我们并没有接着从犹太来论你的信，也没有弟兄到这里来报给我们说你有什么不好处。

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：「我們並沒有接着從猶太來論你的信，也沒有弟兄到這裏來報給我們說你有甚麼不好處。

en.text: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”

zhSimplified.text: 但我们愿意听你的意见如何；因为这教门，我们晓得是到处被毁谤的。」

zhTraditional.text: 但我們願意聽你的意見如何；因為這教門，我們曉得是到處被毀謗的。」

en.text: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

zhSimplified.text: 他们和保罗约定了日子，就有许多人到他的寓处来。保罗从早到晚，对他们讲论这事，证明 神国的道，引摩西的律法和先知的书，以耶稣的事劝勉他们。

zhTraditional.text: 他們和保羅約定了日子，就有許多人到他的寓處來。保羅從早到晚，對他們講論這事，證明上帝國的道，引摩西的律法和先知的書，以耶穌的事勸勉他們。

en.text: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

zhSimplified.text: 他所说的话，有信的，有不信的。

zhTraditional.text: 他所說的話，有信的，有不信的。

en.text: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,

zhSimplified.text: 他们彼此不合，就散了；未散以先，保罗说了一句话，说：「圣灵借先知以赛亚向你们祖宗所说的话是不错的。

zhTraditional.text: 他們彼此不合，就散了；未散以先，保羅說了一句話，說：「聖靈藉先知以賽亞向你們祖宗所說的話是不錯的。

en.text: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

zhSimplified.text: 他说： 你去告诉这百姓说： 你们听是要听见，却不明白； 看是要看见，却不晓得；

zhTraditional.text: 他說： 你去告訴這百姓說： 你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白； 看是要看見，卻不曉得；

en.text: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’

zhSimplified.text: 因为这百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵发沉， 眼睛闭着； 恐怕眼睛看见， 耳朵听见， 心里明白，回转过来， 我就医治他们。

zhTraditional.text: 因為這百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵發沉， 眼睛閉着； 恐怕眼睛看見， 耳朵聽見， 心裏明白，回轉過來， 我就醫治他們。

en.text: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以你们当知道， 神这救恩，如今传给外邦人，他们也必听受。」

footnotes.text: - 28:28 有古卷加： 29 * \+pn 保罗\+pn*说了这话，\+pn 犹太\+pn*人议论纷纷地就走了。

zhTraditional.text: 所以你們當知道，上帝這救恩，如今傳給外邦人，他們也必聽受。」

footnotes.text: - 28:28 有古卷加： 29 \+pn 保羅\+pn*說了這話，\+pn 猶太\+pn*人議論紛紛地就走了。

en.text: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.
Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,

zhSimplified.text: 保罗在自己所租的房子里住了足足两年。凡来见他的人，他全都接待，

zhTraditional.text: 保羅在自己所租的房子裏住了足足兩年。凡來見他的人，他全都接待，

en.text: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

zhSimplified.text: 放胆传讲 神国的道，将主耶稣基督的事教导人，并没有人禁止。

zhTraditional.text: 放膽傳講上帝國的道，將主耶穌基督的事教導人，並沒有人禁止。
